title: Modern Baseball Player Stats Dashboard
description: A responsive dashboard displaying baseball player statistics including batting average, home runs, RBIs, and recent game performance. Composed of a player profile card, stats table, and performance chart components.

components.name: StatBadge
components.description: A compact badge displaying a single statistic label and value. Used across the dashboard to surface key metrics at a glance.

label.description: Short label for the stat, e.g. 'AVG', 'HR', 'RBI'

value.description: Numeric or formatted value of the stat

highlight.description: When true, applies accent styling to draw attention to standout stats

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 shadow-sm border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700 min-w-[80px]

children.tailwind: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Circular player photo with a fallback initials placeholder when no image is available.

src.description: URL of the player headshot image

alt.description: Descriptive alt text for the player image

initials.description: Up to 2-character fallback initials shown when no image is provided

size.description: Controls avatar dimensions. Defaults to 'lg' inside the profile card.

layout.tailwind: flex items-center justify-center rounded-full overflow-hidden bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900 ring-4 ring-blue-500 ring-offset-2

components.name: PositionTag
components.description: Small pill/tag indicating the player's fielding position (e.g. CF, 1B, SP).

layout.tailwind: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-blue-600 text-white

components.name: SectionHeading
components.description: Consistent section title used above major dashboard panels.

subtitle.description: Optional supporting text displayed beneath the title

components.name: PlayerProfileCard
components.description: Displays the player's headshot, full name, team, position tag, jersey number, and a row of key highlight stats (AVG, HR, RBI, OPS). Acts as the hero identity card at the top of the dashboard.

highlightStats.type: Array<{ label: string; value: string | number }>
highlightStats.description: Array of 4 key season stats shown as StatBadge atoms

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center sm:items-start gap-6 p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-700 to-blue-900 text-white shadow-xl w-full

children.tailwind: flex flex-col items-center sm:items-start gap-2 flex-1

children.note: Rendered for each item in highlightStats; applies highlight=true on HR and RBI badges

components.name: StatsTableRow
components.description: A single row inside the season stats table representing one season or one split category.

season.description: Season year or split label, e.g. '2025'

components.name: StatsTable
components.description: Scrollable table listing the player's career or season-by-season batting statistics. Includes a sticky header row and a highlighted row for the current season.

rows.description: Ordered array of season stat rows

caption.description: Accessible table caption, defaults to 'Season Batting Statistics'

layout.tailwind: w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 shadow-sm

children.repeat: per column: Season, Team, G, AB, H, AVG, HR, RBI, OBP, SLG, OPS
children.tailwind: px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider whitespace-nowrap

components.name: PerformanceChartTooltip
components.description: Custom tooltip shown on hover over chart data points, displaying the game date and relevant stat value.

value.description: Stat value at that data point

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-gray-900 text-white text-xs shadow-lg border border-gray-700

components.name: ChartLegend
components.description: Small legend strip displayed above the chart indicating which line/bar colour maps to which stat.

items.description: Legend entries with colour swatch and label

components.name: StatFilterToggle
components.description: A segmented button group allowing the user to switch the chart between different stat views: AVG, HR, RBI, OPS.

onChange.description: Callback fired when the user selects a different option

layout.tailwind: flex items-center gap-1 p-1 rounded-lg bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800 w-fit

tailwind.default: px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-sm font-medium text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 hover:bg-white dark:hover:bg-gray-700 transition-colors
tailwind.active: px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-sm font-medium bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 shadow-sm

accessibility.ariaLabel: Select statistic to display in chart

components.name: PerformanceChart
components.description: Line/area chart visualising the player's stat trend across the last N games of the current season. Includes a stat filter toggle, legend, and custom tooltip. Chart area uses a smooth gradient fill beneath the line.

data.type: Array<{ date: string; avg?: number; hr?: number; rbi?: number; ops?: number }>
data.description: Ordered array of per-game or per-week data points

activeStat.description: Which stat metric is currently displayed

gameCount.description: Number of recent games reflected in the data; shown in the subtitle

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-3 p-6 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 shadow-sm w-full

children.tailwind: flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3

children.note: Chart rendered inside this container using a charting library (e.g. Recharts). Responsive width, fixed height breakpoints.

components.name: RecentGameRow
components.description: A single row in the recent games log showing opponent, game date, and key per-game stats (AB, H, HR, RBI, AVG).

gameDate.description: Date of the game formatted as 'MMM D, YYYY'

layout.tailwind: flex items-center gap-4 px-4 py-3 border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800 last:border-0 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800/50 transition-colors text-sm

tailwind.W: w-6 h-6 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-green-100 text-green-700 dark:bg-green-900/40 dark:text-green-400 text-xs font-bold
tailwind.L: w-6 h-6 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/40 dark:text-red-400 text-xs font-bold

children.tailwind: flex gap-6 text-right text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 text-xs font-mono
children.note: Each stat cell is right-aligned with a fixed min-width for alignment

components.name: RecentGamesPanel
components.description: A scrollable panel listing the player's last 10 game log entries. Each row shows opponent, date, game result badge, and per-game stats.

games.description: Array of recent game log entries, ordered newest first

maxRows.description: Maximum visible rows before scroll kicks in. Defaults to 6.

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 shadow-sm overflow-hidden w-full

children.tailwind: flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800
flex items-center gap-4 px-4 py-2 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400 border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800
children.note: Column header row: Result | Opponent | Date | AB | H | HR | RBI | AVG

components.name: DashboardSidebar
components.description: Right-side panel (on desktop) containing league rank indicators and season milestone callouts (e.g. 'On pace for 40 HR'). Collapses to a horizontal strip below main content on mobile.

leagueRanks.type: Array<{ stat: string; rank: number; total: number }>
leagueRanks.description: Player's league ranking for each major stat category

milestones.description: Season milestone or pace callout strings

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-4 w-full lg:w-72 shrink-0

children.tailwind: rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 shadow-sm p-5
rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-50 to-amber-100 dark:from-amber-900/30 dark:to-amber-800/20 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-700/50 shadow-sm p-5
flex items-start gap-2 text-sm text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300

components.name: DashboardHeader
components.description: Top navigation bar of the dashboard containing the app logo/wordmark, a search input for switching players, a dark-mode toggle, and a notification bell icon.

appName.description: Application name displayed in the header

layout.tailwind: flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-3 bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800 sticky top-0 z-30 shadow-sm

children.tailwind: w-full px-4 py-2 rounded-full border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 placeholder:text-gray-400

children.note: Dark mode toggle — renders sun or moon icon depending on current mode

children.tailwind: p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors relative
children.note: Notification bell; badge overlaid with unread count

components.name: BaseballStatsDashboardTemplate
components.description: Page-level layout template that wires together DashboardHeader, PlayerProfileCard, PerformanceChart, StatsTable, RecentGamesPanel, and DashboardSidebar into the full-page responsive grid.

isLoading.description: Shows skeleton placeholders across all panels while data is loading

gridAreas.mobile: Single column stack: ProfileCard → PerformanceChart → StatsTable → RecentGamesPanel → Sidebar content
gridAreas.desktop: Two-column layout: left main column (flex-1) + right sidebar (w-72). Main column contains ProfileCard, PerformanceChart, StatsTable, RecentGamesPanel stacked vertically.

children.tailwind: flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-6 p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 max-w-screen-xl mx-auto w-full flex-1

components.name: BaseballStatsDashboardPage
components.description: Top-level page component. Consumes the BaseballStatsDashboardTemplate and is responsible for data-fetching orchestration, URL parameter reading (player ID), and global error boundary rendering.

playerId.description: Unique identifier for the player whose stats are displayed, typically sourced from route params

errorState.description: Full-page error panel with a friendly message and a retry button when the data request fails
errorState.tailwind: flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-screen gap-4 text-center p-8

breakpoints.sm: 640px — single-column switches to two-column header controls
breakpoints.lg: 1024px — main content + sidebar side-by-side grid activates

interactions.action: Updates activeStat state; PerformanceChart re-renders with selected metric data; active button receives bg-white shadow styling
Displays PerformanceChartTooltip with game date and stat value adjacent to the hovered point
Row background transitions to bg-blue-50 (light) / bg-blue-900/20 (dark) to indicate interactivity
Row background transitions to bg-gray-50 (light) / bg-gray-800/50 (dark)
Triggers onSearch callback with current input value; parent page handles player switching and triggers loading state across all panels
Toggles dark class on the HTML root element; all dark: Tailwind variants activate; icon swaps between sun and moon
Horizontal scroll on mobile reveals hidden stat columns; sticky thead remains visible during vertical scroll on desktop
Vertical scroll reveals additional game log rows beyond the visible max-h-[360px] window
Responsive breakpoints reorganise layout: single-column on mobile → two-column with sidebar on lg+; chart height adjusts via breakpoint-specific h- classes
